entities.summary: Hristo Tsvetanov is a Bulgarian male volleyball player who was a member of the Bulgaria men's national volleyball team. He was a part of the Bulgarian national team that competed in the 2008 Summer Olympics. At club level, Tsvetanov started his career in Lokomotiv Sofia and then moved to Levski Siconco Sofia. He later played for Diatec Trentino in Italy and Olympiacos in Greece.
